splunkUrl.title: Splunk URL
splunkUrl.description: The URL of your Splunk server. No need to set the protocol prefix.

token.title: Token
token.description: The Token of the HEC. Note it is not the user's authentication token.

hostPayload.title: Host of the Event
hostPayload.description: The host field set in the data sent to Splunk, it is not related to the Splunk URL or the connection to Splunk server.

bodyOnly.title: Body Only
bodyOnly.description: Send to Splunk only data contained in the body.

headersOnly.title: Headers Only
headersOnly.description: Send to Splunk only data contained in the headers.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source named field of the data.

sourceType.title: Source Type
sourceType.description: The source named field of the data.

time.title: Time
time.description: Time this event occurred. By default, the time is when this event hits the Splunk server.
